name: contract-test-policy
goal: Only five contract-driven suites; stable bug case counts; matching visual and JSON evidence; complete Git history reconstruction

evidence: Approved scope is this repository’s workspaces, generators and agent guidance: exactly page/component screenshot matching, helper Examples, class method/state cases and complete API JSON comparisons. Stable case counts, error props, revision-bound artifacts and full Git-only history reconstruction are required; external app migration and production are excluded.

Inventory is 1110 suite files and 4581 discovered declarations. The current qualified migration covers 44 units and 692 cases; 5887 gaps remain and global testing cutover is disabled. Existing cases exposed count inflation, authored-data loss and dropped class audio. Visual baselines, remaining module migrations, normal aggregate verification, manual Explorer flows and exhaustive history remain pending.
